concept: A real homepage, built and screenshotted, for a made-up florist (Thistlewick Flowers, Tynemouth): cream, deep green, one raspberry pink, a tall serif. The post is the website: the whole first screen, then its photograph edge to edge, then the foot of the phone version with its two fixed buttons, then the next section with the call to action. Deep green frames so the cream site stands off them.
